answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a marble bet on surviving 65 epochs of grading, and every ferrous settlement recomputes the cipher schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 65 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 24 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
